answer: An attacker forging ten thousand identities still pays ten thousand times the energy, making sybils economically irrational. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted proof-of-work tied to scarce compute, where each agent must burn verifiable GPU cycles on a unique challenge before voting. Like a pigment that marks each bee, the burned cycles leave an unforgeable trace, and rewards flow only to those who reach the epoch summit having gathered real nectar of verified work. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
